# Veep

> Veep brings founders, funds, and business teams senior operating capacity to prepare for transactions, grow revenue, and test expansion while their teams keep running the business.

A lead operating partner owns the agreed work. Specialist partners and agents can support the scope where useful. The client keeps its business decisions and approvals.

## For agents

- [Full Veep overview](https://www.veep.work/llms-full.txt): Markdown with buyer outcomes, engagement models, starting prices, case results, and contact links.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://www.veep.work/): Operating partner model and selected work.
- [For founders and business teams](https://www.veep.work/for-companies): Company engagements and cases.
- [For funds](https://www.veep.work/for-portfolios): Single-company engagements, Portfolio Roster, and the Portfolio Capacity Audit.
- [Pricing](https://www.veep.work/pricing#tiers): Engagement terms and starting prices.
- [FAQ](https://www.veep.work/faq): Fit, timing, and common questions.
- [Contact](https://www.veep.work/contact): Inquiries and introductions.
